high_risk_reason: Bhakoot dosha and its cancellation (same rashi lord; lords mutual friends) are load-bearing and school-variable. Cancellation is handled ONLY in parihara.json (disabled by default) and is never silently applied here.
description: Bhakoot (Rashi / Bhakut) koota — emotional bonding, family welfare and prosperity from the mutual rashi-to-rashi position of the two Moon signs. Penalized positions score 0; all others score the full 7.

counting_rule.description: Count from rashi A to rashi B (inclusive, forward) and from B to A. The unordered pair of counts identifies the relationship. Same rashi = 1/1.
counting_rule.formula_note: count_ab = ((B - A) mod 12) + 1 ; count_ba = ((A - B) mod 12) + 1

scoring.rule: If the unordered pair of mutual counts equals {2,12}, {5,9}, or {6,8} -> 0 (Bhakoot dosha). Otherwise -> 7.

dosha.name: Bhakoot dosha
dosha.severity_note: 6/8 and 2/12 are traditionally regarded as more serious than 5/9 in some schools; this pack applies a uniform 0 for all three pending review.
dosha.cancellation: Handled in parihara.json ONLY (bhakoot_cancel_same_rashi_lord, bhakoot_cancel_lords_friends) — disabled by default.

notes: Sanskrit term: Bhakoot / Bhakut / Rashi koota.
Symmetric: swapping the two rashis yields the same count-pair (directional=false).
Whether all three dosha types are weighted equally (uniform 0) vs differentiated is PENDING_DOMAIN_REVIEW.
